description_expanded: Spacious & Thoughtfully Designed Interiors Brand-New Furnishings & Hardwood Floors – A clean, modern aesthetic with warm coastal charm. Bright & Airy Living Space – High ceilings with stained beams, large windows, and a spacious layout. Fully Equipped Gourmet Kitchen – Features new appliances, a walk-in pantry, and a breakfast bar, perfect for preparing meals together. First-Level Primary Suite –King-sized bed, TV, and walk-in closet. Private en-suite bath with double vanity and a massive double-head shower. Nearby half-bath & laundry room with new washer and dryer. Luxurious Bedrooms & Family-Friendly Spaces Second-Level Primary Suite – Private balcony, king-sized bed, TV, and walk-in closet. Private en-suite bath with double vanity and oversized double-head shower. Guest Suite (King) – Private balcony, TV, walk-in closet, and en-suite bath. Shower/tub combo and double vanity. Large Bunk Room + Extra Queen Bed – Two twin bunks (four beds) plus a queen-sized bed. TV, reading lights, shelves, electrical outlets, and USB ports at each bunk. Private bath with shower/tub combo. Bonus Game Nook – A perfect hangout for kids, featuring:Pullout sofa, TV, and Xbox One for entertainment. Outdoor Living & Resort-Style Amenities Back Deck with Gas Grill – Grilling tools provided for cookouts and outdoor dining. Beach Gear Closet – Stocked with chairs, umbrellas, and essentials for fun in the sun. Outdoor Shower – Rinse off after a day at the beach. Easy Access to Seacrest Beach’s Famous 12,000-Square-Foot Pool –Just outside your back door, follow the quaint tree-lined trail to one of the largest lagoon-style pools in Florida! Seasonal Beach Tram (March–October) – Steps from your front door, this convenient tram takes you to the beach access point. Off-Season Beach Access – A short walk or bike ride away. Follow the quaint tree-lined trail outside your back door, which provides access to the famous 12,000-square-foot lagoon-style pool - the largest in 30A, and the second largest in all of Florida. A truly unique space. Just steps away from your front door is a tram stop providing seasonal tram service to the beach access in Seacrest Beach (March-October). In the off-season, beach access is just a short walk or bike ride away.
